title: Local dimension inequality for an integral dominant morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-pc-integral-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth] be a dominant morphism locally of finite type between integral schemes, with $S$ locally Noetherian. For $x\in X$ and $s=f(x)$, let $\eta_S$ and $\eta_X$ be the generic points and write $R(S)=\mathcal O_{S,\eta_S}$ and $R(X)=\mathcal O_{X,\eta_X}$ for their function fields [def-sc-generic-point, def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and write $\kappa(s),\kappa(x)$ for residue fields [def-weil-residue-field, def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Then [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] $$\dim(\mathcal O_{X,x})\leq\dim(\mathcal O_{S,s})+\operatorname{trdeg}_{R(S)}R(X)-\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(s)}\kappa(x).$$
